source: BLS CPI; CME FedWatch via Forbes; Freddie Mac via NAHB

headline: Inflation runs hot,
a *Fed hike* looms
slides.fig_caption: Monthly rise in consumer prices in October 2026
slides.sub: That beat the 0.3% forecast, and markets now see a December rate hike as near certain.

slides.title: Where prices *moved*
slides.note: Core prices, which exclude food and energy, rose 0.3% against a *0.2% forecast*.

slides.label: odds of a quarter-point hike *in December*
slides.body: FedWatch put another 10.8% on a half-point move after the report. The Fed held at 3.75% to 4% in October, with two officials already voting to raise.

slides.label: average 30-year rate in October, *up 108 bps* from a year ago
slides.body: Freddie Mac's monthly average jumped 47 basis points from September as inflation picked back up.

slides.title: Don't sell the *rate drop*
slides.body: Clients waiting for cheaper money may wait a while. Help them plan around today's payment, using concessions, buydowns and an early lender call.
